description: PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "any prediction-market mispricings right now". Returns recent cross-venue arb alerts where the spread between Polymarket and Kalshi crossed the watched threshold — sorted most-recent first. Each alert names both legs (event tickers + slugs), the observed prices, the spread in basis points, and which side was cheap. Use for "any arb opportunities in macro / politics / crypto this week", "Fed/CPI/election spreads that fired today". Cron polls every 4h during US market hours; alerts persist 30+ days.

hours.description: Look-back window in hours. Default 24, max 720 (30 days).

limit.description: Max alerts to return. Default 50, max 500.

name: arb_recent_alerts
title: Arb Recent Alerts
